comment: 更新日志：手动维护，每次改版在最前面加一条。version 用日期（YYYY-MM-DD），/more 页的红点靠它判断有没有新内容。

items: 第一版上线：首版只收纽约 Housing Connect 公开抽签，按截止日排序，每半小时刷新；标题与简介全部自己改写，不转载原文。
items_en: First release: covers only public NYC Housing Connect lotteries, sorted by deadline and refreshed every 30 minutes. All titles and summaries are written by this site; no original text is republished.
